 P.S.- CHENARI, DIST.- ROHTAS (SASARAM)

Versus  1. THE STATE OF BIHAR  2. PRIYANKA DEVI WIFE OF LALBABU SAH AND DAUGHTER OF  DUDHNATH SAH PRESENTLY RESIDING AT VILLAGE - BELAON,
 P.S.- BELAON, DISTRICT- KAIMUR (BHABHUA)
 ... ...

Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Shivjee Singh  For the Opposite Party/s : Mrs. Pushpa Sinha.1  Mrs. Kiran Kumari Sharma  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 3 20-02-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 341, 323, 504, 506, 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party no2., is said to have ousted the opposite party no.2 from her matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.46890 of 2022(3) dt.20-02-2023 demand.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.
Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over the demand of dowry.

He is still ready to keep her with Lalbabu Sah vs The State Of Bihar on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36990329/
1 full honour and dignity.
